original_role: NT4 kernel/user V86 monitor executable package
rationale: The selected i386+CCPU graph has no monitor body, monitor library or MONITOR define; preserve exact source only as indexed historical evidence.
It constructs the old product shell and fake devices; it is neither the CCPU interpreter nor a modern session adapter.
It only enumerates the removed monitor/scaffold and retained QUIT utility package.
It is a standalone historical tool and must remain outside the main host-runtime graph.
Its `monitor.lib` entry is removed under MVDM-HOST-DIV-031; all other original library order remains intact.
A textual historical `monitor.lib` mention is not a source, build or runtime input and remains only provenance evidence.
Lexical V86 terms are guest CPU semantics selected by the original CCPU source manifest, not kernel VDM/MONITOR implementation inputs.
The selected CCPU branch is guarded by !MONITOR and has formal x86/x64 execution evidence.
